# Soline AutoCAD Setup — matching manual dimensions to the Soline template

When the owner draws a dimension **by hand** in AutoCAD it must look like the ones our
DXF exports produce. This is delivered as a one-time AutoCAD script,
**`_LATEST/SOLINE_setup.scr`**, generated by `src/layout_sheets.js`
(`buildSetupScr()`) directly from the same layer/style tables the exporter uses — so
the CAD-side template and the DXF are identical by construction.

---

## 1. Run it once

1. Open AutoCAD (a new drawing, or the drawing you want set up).
2. Type **`SCRIPT`** ↵ (or *Tools ▸ Run Script*).
3. Select **`SOLINE_setup.scr`**.
4. It runs top-to-bottom and configures the drawing. Done.

> On a **fresh** drawing AutoCAD may print a harmless `Unknown command "Y"` after the
> dimension style is saved (the `Y` only answers an overwrite prompt that appears on a
> *re-run*). Ignore it — the style is already created.

---

## 2. What it creates

**Drawing units** — metric, millimetres, decimal, `LTSCALE 10` (matches the DXF
`$LTSCALE`).

**Linetypes** — loads `HIDDEN` and `CENTER` from `acad.lin` (used by the hidden /
centreline layers).

**Text style `SOLINE`** — `arial.ttf` (Hebrew-capable, a Windows system font),
height 0 (each text sets its own height), upright. Same style name and font the DXF
`STYLE` table uses, so Hebrew renders identically.

**Layers** — the **complete Soline taxonomy** (71 layers), each created with the
**same name, ACI colour and linetype** as the DXF `LAYER` table: the discipline
layers (`קירות`, `חשמל`, `תאורה`, `מים` …), their `-מידות / -טקסט / -מילוי / -נסתר`
kinds, and the sheet/annotation layers (`מידות-פנים`, `מידות-חוץ`, `מסגרת`,
`גבול-גיליון`, `מקרא` …). Names are space-free (R12 rule). The current layer is set
to **`מידות-פנים`** (the measured/clear dimensions layer) so a dimension you draw
lands on the right layer immediately.

**Dimension style `SOLINE`** — tuned to match our DXF dim appearance at **1:50**:

| Variable | Value | Meaning |
|----------|-------|---------|
| `DIMSCALE` | 50 | overall annotation scale (plot at 1:50) |
| `DIMTXT` | 2.5 | text height = 2.5 mm on paper |
| `DIMASZ` | 2.5 | filled arrowhead (our SOLID arrow) |
| `DIMEXE` | 1.25 | extension line beyond the dim line |
| `DIMEXO` | 0.9 | extension offset from the measured point |
| `DIMGAP` | 0.9 | gap around the dim text |
| **`DIMLFAC`** | **0.1** | **linear factor mm→cm: a 4000 mm pick reads `400`** |
| `DIMDEC` | 1 | one decimal (like our `cm()`) |
| `DIMZIN` | 8 | suppress trailing zeros (`400.0`→`400`) |
| `DIMTAD` | 1 | text **above** the dim line |
| `DIMTIH`/`DIMTOH` | 0 | text aligned **with** the dim line |
| `DIMCLRD`/`DIMCLRE`/`DIMCLRT` | 256 | ByLayer colours |
| `DIMTXSTY` | `SOLINE` | uses the Arial text style above |

**The measured-clear rule applies to manual dims too:** a plain AutoCAD linear
dimension measures the **clear distance between the two points you pick** — so if the
surveyor picks the two inner wall faces he gets the true room dimension (e.g. `400`),
never the wall-thickness-inflated outer sum (`420`). `DIMLFAC 0.1` makes that reading
appear in **cm**, exactly like the exported drawings.

---

## 3. Plotting

- **Plot style table:** choose **`SOLINE.ctb`** (already installed under *Plot Styles*
  — see `_LATEST/CTB_INSTALL_GUIDE.md`). It maps each ACI colour to its Soline pen
  width, which is why the layers keep fixed colours.
- **Fonts:** Arial (system TrueType) — nothing to install.
- **Sheets:** plot the per-sheet files 1:1; the scale is on each title block (see
  `docs/PRINT_LAYOUTS.md`).

---

## 4. English-named variant

The Hebrew layer names are written as CP1255 bytes to match the DXF byte-for-byte and
render on a Hebrew Windows locale. If the names ever appear garbled (a non-Hebrew
system locale), regenerate an ASCII underscore-named variant
(`Walls`, `Electrical`, `Dim_Inner` …):

```bash
SOLINE_SCR_LANG=en node src/layout_sheets.js
```

The dimension style, text style and plotting steps are identical; only the layer
names differ.

---

## 5. A `.dwt` template?

A binary `.dwt` (drawing template) cannot be authored headlessly without a running
AutoCAD, so the **`.scr` is the deliverable**. To turn it into a reusable template on
the owner's machine: run `SOLINE_setup.scr` on a new empty drawing, then
**SAVEAS ▸ AutoCAD Drawing Template (\*.dwt)** as `SOLINE.dwt`. Every new drawing
started from it then carries the Soline layers, text style and `SOLINE` dimension
style with zero further setup.
